doc.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024

title: Closing thanks and the truth
summary: Rowe thanks Griffin; Griffin says everything he told was the truth, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I appreciate all this knowledge and stories you’ve told me and it’s been a highlight for me.
Oh thank you so much. It’s, you know, the thing, out of the whole thing is the truth. See everything that I told you is straight up, the straight up truth you know. And you know I

didn’t butter it up. I just had to tell you the truth. And that’s what’s so strong now. They said there’s a saying that the truth will set you free you know, and it will. And it’s just — if you tell the truth you don’t have to have a good memory.
Well said. Thanks for your time. Congratulations on your career.
All right. So thank you so much. I’ve enjoyed sharing and it’s been a pleasure. Thank you so much.
